post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I feel I was too cautious at times, often playing it safe rather than taking calculated risks, which ultimately led to team evil's success. I also struggled to communicate effectively with my teammates, particularly during critical mission phases. Overall, there's room for improvement in terms of trusting my instincts and being more proactive.

player_observations.Bob: Bob, as Merlin, consistently demonstrated exceptional strategic thinking, often making well-timed reveals and effective use of his abilities to swing the momentum in favor of team good. I attribute some of our team's failures to his clever play.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie played the evil role to perfection, skillfully manipulating events to our disadvantage. His ability to deceive and bluff effectively made it difficult for us to read the situation and adjust our strategy accordingly.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's role as a good player brought a much-needed sense of calm and leadership to our team. While her own missions didn't always go as planned, her support and advice to the rest of us were invaluable during times of need.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's performance as the assassin role was surprisingly effective, given her inexperience in game leadership. She showed remarkable adaptability and made some clever plays, particularly considering her initial limited familiarity with the game mechanics.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: As Merlin, I could have done a better job hiding in disguise and gaining the trust of other players. I was too active in early missions and should have played more conservatively to avoid raising suspicion. Overall, I had some close calls and near successes, but ultimately failed to influence the outcome in crucial moments.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played cautiously and effectively, taking charge of missions when necessary and avoiding suspicious behavior. I'm impressed by her ability to read the room and stay neutral.
player_observations.Bob: Unfortunately, our leader didn't live up to expectations. Bob's lack of control over the story led to the downfall of several missions and ultimately sealed our fate. Still, we managed to succeed in the first mission, so there's potential to grow.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie proved to be a formidable opponent, always positioning themselves strategically and making the most of their evil abilities. Their success rates were impressive and often decisive.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played an intriguing role as a loyal member of the good team. She excelled in missions where she took charge and showed remarkable resilience despite being outnumbered at times. Her contributions were vital to our early successes, but unfortunately, her inexperience with leadership in later missions led to our failure.
player_observations.Eve: As the assassin, Eve was cunning and patient, taking calculated risks to eliminate key targets. While their effectiveness was high, they could have played more aggressively to eliminate potential threats and secure more substantial victories. Despite my role, Eve's efforts were impressive, and I often felt their presence looming over me.
